header.assessment: The supplier name on the entry print, "EXSTARD CO LTD", is a clear match for the supplier name on the commercial invoice, "Exstard Co., Ltd.". The difference in capitalization and abbreviation is acceptable under the fuzzy matching rule.

The incoterm on the entry print is "FCA", while the "Terms of Trade" on the commercial invoice is "Free on Board". "Free on Board" corresponds to the incoterm FOB, not FCA. As FCA and FOB are distinct incoterms with different rules and points of risk transfer, this is a mismatch.
The currency code on the entry print is "JPY", which matches the "Currency Code" of "JPY" on the commercial invoice. The values are consistent.

The invoice number field is not explicitly populated on the entry print. Similarly, the "Invoice No:" field on the commercial invoice is blank. As both values are missing, the check defaults to PASS according to the special considerations.
The shipper name on the air waybill is "Exstard Co., Ltd.", which is an exact match for the supplier name on the commercial invoice, "Exstard Co., Ltd.".
The consignee name on the air waybill, "Kyatchi Cards Pty Ltd Colin Hui", is an exact match for the buyer name on the commercial invoice, "Kyatchi Cards Pty Ltd Colin Hui".

header.assessment: The country of origin on the entry print is listed as "JP" in the ORIGIN/PREF column. This is consistent with the country of origin "JAPAN" listed in the COO column on the commercial invoice.

The country of export can be inferred from the shipper's address on the air waybill, which is "Japan". The country of export on the entry print can be inferred from the "LOAD PT" field, which is "JPNRT", indicating Japan. The countries are consistent.

The air waybill's routing information "OMELJP-OSA-OAA" indicates the origin airport is Osaka (OSA). However, the entry print lists the "LOAD PT" (Port of Loading) as "JPNRT", which is Narita, Tokyo. These are two different airports in different cities, so this is a mismatch.
The total weight on the air waybill is "3.5 kg". This matches the "GRWT (KG)" of "3.50 KG" on the entry print. The minor difference in decimal places is acceptable.
The number of pieces on the air waybill is "1". This matches the "TOTAL NUMBER OF PACKAGES" of "1" on the entry print.

The goods description on the entry print is "TRADING CARD GAME SET PAPER MADE PAPER". This is consistent with the item description on the commercial invoice, "Trading Card, Paper made". Both descriptions clearly refer to the same product.
